description: Frontend image upload wiring for Hotel OS. Create Supabase browser client helpers, images API module, reusable ImageUploadSlot dashboard component, update dashboard profile page to show real images, update onboarding step-5 to upload to Supabase. Depends on FEAT-001 (backend endpoints must exist for images.ts API calls to resolve correctly, though build-time type checking does not require them to be running).
steps: Create c:/Users/Pkaka/music/hotel-os/app/lib/supabase.ts. Import createClient from '@supabase/supabase-js' (already in package.json at ^2.117.3). Create and export a lazy singleton: let _client; function getSupabaseClient() { if (!_client) _client = createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!, process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!); return _client; }. Export async function uploadImage(file: File, hotelId: string, category: string): Promise<string> — generates path `${hotelId}/${category}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${file.name.split('.').pop()}`, calls getSupabaseClient().storage.from(BUCKET).upload(path, file, { upsert: false }), throws on error, returns getSupabaseClient().storage.from(BUCKET).getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl. Export function extractStoragePath(publicUrl: string): string — finds the bucket name in the URL and returns everything after '/object/public/<bucket>/'. Export async function deleteImage(storagePath: string): Promise<void> — calls getSupabaseClient().storage.from(BUCKET).remove([storagePath]), throws on error. BUCKET = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET ?? 'hotel-images'.

Create c:/Users/Pkaka/music/hotel-os/app/lib/api/images.ts. Import apiClient from './client'. Export type HotelImage { id: string; hotelId: string; url: string; caption: string | null; isPrimary: boolean; sortOrder: number; createdAt: string; }. Export: getHotelImages(hotelId: string) => apiClient.get<HotelImage[]>(`/api/v1/hotels/${hotelId}/images`); saveHotelImage(hotelId: string, dto: { url: string; caption?: string; isPrimary?: boolean; sortOrder?: number }) => apiClient.post<HotelImage>(`/api/v1/hotels/${hotelId}/images`, dto); deleteHotelImage(hotelId: string, imageId: string) => apiClient.delete<void>(`/api/v1/hotels/${hotelId}/images/${imageId}`); setImagePrimary(hotelId: string, imageId: string) => apiClient.patch<HotelImage>(`/api/v1/hotels/${hotelId}/images/${imageId}/primary`).
